text: I answer questions about FDA reports and recalls for medical devices: how many reports a device has (deaths, injuries, malfunctions), what problems are reported, whether it was recalled and why, what happened in the reports, and who makes a device or what a UDI or product code is. For example: "Was the DreamStation recalled, and why?" I can't give medical advice or judge whether a device is safe.
